description: jobs: Get or poll a job. GET /v1/jobs/{id}. Poll a job created by adding async=true, or the header Prefer: respond-async, to any GET /v1 request. A queued job has not been charged. A finished job's result is the operation body, charged once through the normal ledger. Failed, empty, expired and cancelled jobs cost 0. Costs 0 credits when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

id.description: Job id from the 202 response. Pass that id and nothing else.
